name: lodestash
description: Root task runner — the app and its gates, runnable from the repo root. Frontend deps live in crates/lodestash-desktop/ui.

scripts.setup: bun install --cwd crates/lodestash-desktop/ui && bun install --cwd web
scripts.web:check: bun run --cwd web check && node scripts/design/check-styles.mjs && node scripts/design/gen-icons.mjs --check
